html_title: 1Final accuracy and learning curves. Left: passed-case bars (gray: native; red: RSI-PDE). Right: learning curves (black: native; red: RSI-PDE). Both halves have Opus 5.5 above GPT-5.5, with Full, Noisy and Hard-OOD columns. Labels give final counts and RSI-minus-native case gains. Axes are locally zoomed; cropped bar baselines are marked. The native Opus Full curve whisker shows the observed 187–198 range over three runs. Curves preserve regressions and stopping rounds. and give all models and baselines.
